prompt:
FRAME FORMAT: Six 512 x 512 pixel cells, arranged as an exactly aligned 3-column x 2-row sheet, 1536 x 1024 pixels total. All cells share one physical pixel scale; preserve the relative size of modules. Even spacing, transparent outer margins within each cell, stable mounting pivots. Export with true alpha transparency, no opaque backdrop.
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production modular boss sprite sheet for the existing Bullets of Fury: Overdrive top-down arcade tank game.
Reference image 1: the CURRENT original Warrior sheet, for its identity, helmet, green/charcoal armor, orange vent lights, red eyes and industrial pixel texture. Regenerate this original boss as a much more imposing, clearly readable heavy tank boss. Keep its warrior helmet identity; do not create a humanoid walker or copy another franchise.
Style: richly detailed crisp arcade pixel sprite, dark outlines, controlled highlights, green armored plates, silver steel trims, dark charcoal tracks, orange exhaust vents, red visor. Slight raised front-facing helmet/arms above a top-down tracked chassis, same game viewpoint as the reference.
Six isolated reusable modules, each cleanly contained in its own cell, no labels:
Top left: intact massive twin-track chassis, facing NORTH, broad heavy tracks, low angular front armor, large circular turret mounting ring at the physical center. Symmetrical silhouette. Approximately 420 pixels wide and 420 pixels long within the 512 cell, center ring near (256,256).
Top middle: warrior helmet and compact armored central torso as ONE removable turret module. Red eyes, silver angular knight helmet with a short crest, bulky olive shoulder armor, squat industrial body. Smaller than the chassis at the SAME scale, approximately 300 pixels wide by 330 pixels tall. Lower central mounting socket at about (256,360). Looking SOUTH toward the player. No tracks, no detached arms.
Top right: LEFT weapon arm as a single removable module. Heavy shoulder joint at upper INNER RIGHT, olive articulated gun block, triple forward cannon tubes and a six-tube rocket rack. Overall approximately 200 pixels wide and 330 pixels long at the shared scale, shoulder mount near (340,120). Weapon tubes point SOUTH, not diagonal.
Bottom left: RIGHT weapon arm, exact mirrored counterpart of the left, same dimensions, same palette and physical scale. Shoulder mount near (172,120). Cannons point SOUTH.
Bottom middle: damaged version of the EXACT top-left chassis. Same registered tracks, same circular center, identical footprint and pivot; cracked armor and exposed smoldering machinery, restrained orange fire confined inside the chassis.
Bottom right: collapsed wreck of the SAME chassis. Same tracks and footprint and mounting pivot, dark broken armor, inward collapsed ring. Small ember vents; no debris scattered beyond the cell.
Constraints: all parts share common perspective and proportional scale, mirrored gun arms, no full assembled boss in a module cell, no text, no HUD, no frame border, no labels, no floor, no shadows baked outside the metal, no background glow. Keep each module complete with safe transparent margins. This is a larger-resolution rebuilt original Warrior for an epic fight; no stretching, no hammerhead head.
normalization: Six uniform 512x512 crops, original alpha, fixed registration. No per-pose fitting or stretching.
